initial_review.decision: Changes requested: directly bind receiver copies to the validated delivery label and filename.

findings.finding: Receiving copies were compared with a receipt-selected source path but were not directly bound to the artifact corresponding to the delivery label and filename. Later Blender receipts bound final.glb, but a mislabeled raw.glb could satisfy the retained raw-receiver identity checks.
findings.required_change: Map every deliveries/{id}/{raw.glb|final.glb} entry directly to artifact_paths[id]/filename; require both exact relocated source-path equality and copied/receipt/expected-artifact SHA equality.
findings.final_resolution: Corrected code checks the artifact-map IDs, builds expected_sources from the validated artifact map, requires relocated source equality, and binds all three SHA values to that expected source.

checks.name: Path-safe files-only archive extraction
checks.evidence: relative_path rejects absolute, parent, backslash and noncanonical paths. Extraction admits only non-sparse ordinary files, rejects duplicate or undeclared members and file-ancestor collisions, uses containment-resolved children and exclusive file creation, and never calls extractall.

checks.name: Archive and replay-map integrity
checks.evidence: Archive bytes and SHA bind to RECORDED-EVIDENCE; replay map SHA binds to the descriptor; manifest paths are unique and sizes nonnegative; each extracted file must match its declared exact size and SHA; the seen inventory must equal the manifest.

checks.name: Fail-closed, nonoverwriting restoration
checks.evidence: Output must be new and outside/not containing the source checkout. Failed extraction/audit records passed=false. Original receipts are retained rather than rewritten; all relocated paths use explicit prefix mappings and containment checks.

checks.name: No native or receiving execution on replay entry path
checks.evidence: The helper has no subprocess, shell or network calls. Imports use the supplied source checkout; native-capable main/command/reopen functions in imported orchestration modules are guarded or uncalled. The called source, provenance and numerical readers are data readers. Bytecode writes are disabled.

checks.name: Exact inherited readers and frozen gates
checks.evidence: public_inputs verifies the frozen C195 closure; C194 common.verify_freeze and the inherited C193 reader.verify_frozen run before numerical reviews. artifact_reader imports C193 check_artifact with only frozen G/H case-map additions. Provenance audit uses the inherited candidate review and contract closure; the unchanged 0.2 mm bound remains enforced.

checks.name: 481 saved-sample comparisons and saved-scene provenance
checks.evidence: Each mapped reopen must contain exactly 481 records identical to its submitted native trace. Summary hashes bind source, original scene.blend, canonical input, backend and exact inspector, with cache reset/configuration/no-reconstruction flags. Original result hashes bind the retained summary, configuration and both traces.

checks.name: H baseline preservation and regeneration
checks.evidence: source_and_baseline checks exact accepted source/localized G delta and C194 acceptance identity. The entire mapped baseline artifact inventory must equal BASELINES. Four required output hashes must match each coordinator rebuild, and each H output must additionally equal its accepted original.

checks.name: Independent author evidence mapping logic
checks.evidence: check_author_audit requires the independent receipt to bind the freeze, input and delivery manifests; maps and hashes all raw evidence references; and ties each declared source/run inventory to mapped bytes. This reviews the binding mechanism only; it does not evaluate or approve either author performance.

checks.name: Receiving identities after correction
checks.evidence: Every copied raw/final GLB is now bound by exact path and hash to the validated delivery artifact. Khronos and Three receipts cover all eight paths and bind their hashes; four Blender import receipts bind actual final GLBs and retain twelve hashed PNGs.

checks.name: Visual and final acceptance identities
checks.evidence: Visual review must pass and contain twelve unique panels whose exact path/hash/size set equals the receiver panels. Final acceptance binds numerical results, independent author audit, visual review and optional separate automated finalization by SHA.

checks.name: Restoration portability design
checks.evidence: Longest-prefix mappings relocate original absolute provenance references under the extraction root; missing mappings fail. Repository source/checker dependencies are resolved from --repo. No original output directory is used as a fallback. Actual archive/map restoration remains unexecuted and is required separately.

no_native_statement: No native construction, saved-scene replay, receiving process, author dispatch or network operation was performed in this tooling review. The corrected replay helper was not executed.
